# Test output fixtures

Real output captured on 2026-10-12 from pytest 8.4, ctest 4.4 (cmake), Unity (C, gcc), jest 29
and vitest 2, each running 4-5 tests with one failure and one skip. Local paths are replaced
with `<tmp>` and `<home>`. Formats with no tool on the capture machine (GoogleTest, cargo, go,
generic TAP, HIL) are written inline in `test/test-formats.test.ts` from their documented output.
